verdict.rationale: Companies House publishes its own API versioning guide, but the evidence says versioning is only a "proposed approach" while the API is in beta. Existing resources are held 'as is' at version 0. That gives a stability commitment of sorts, but no actual versioned endpoints are evidenced, and no deprecation policy is documented. Missing for 10: implemented versioned API releases, a documented deprecation policy with timelines/notice periods, independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: In the meantime existing resources will remain 'as is' and can be considered as at 'version 0'.
The developer suite publishes dedicated Authorisation, Rate limiting and API versioning guides alongside it.
We have a proposed approach to versioning the API and documentation
